result.narrative: Whole-model performance and coverage. Complete structural and compositional coverage reached with 8 node splits and ZERO function-changing operations - the explained network is computationally identical to the trained one. Wider generalisation gap (0.049 AUC) on the small 61-row test split.

Full ablation ladder, re-verified end-to-end on the test split. Nonlinearity as a whole buys +0.037 test AUC, but the benefit comes almost entirely from the two shallow gates encoding recognised protective/risk factors. The elaborate composed gate contributes nothing on held-out data. A complete explanation doubles as a diagnosis of how much nonlinear structure earns its place.

payload.conclusion: the two simple gates (benign, restbp) carry all the generalising benefit; the elaborate 534 aggregation gate is train-only
payload.description: Full ablation ladder, test AUC, baseline 0.897 (re-verified on test split today)

annotations.hypothesis: Root: y0 = ReLU(bias 0.318 + linear core + 3 nonlinear pathways). (1) DIRECT LINEAR CORE of 17 inputs to the output - ca (largest, +2.03), cp:4 (+1.21), slope:2, chol, cp:2, oldpeak push risk up; sex:0 (-0.71), slope:1, thalach push down. By SHAP the top drivers are ca, cp:4, sex:0, slope:2, chol. (2) benign_profile_gate (155_a, -0.96) lowers risk for females without exertional angina. (3) restbp_chol_interaction (2379, +0.364). (4) risk_aggregation_gate (534, -0.884), the elaborate composed unit. 7 features unused. PERFORMANCE: train AUC 0.946 / test 0.897. ABLATION LADDER (test AUC, baseline 0.897): linear-core only 0.860 (nonlinearity buys +0.037); remove benign gate -0.028; remove restbp -0.012; remove 534 gate +0.002. So the two simple gates (benign, restbp) carry all the generalising benefit; the elaborate 534 aggregation gate is train-only. The benign signal is redundantly encoded twice (155_a direct + 155_b inside 534).
